subtitle: The invisible hand that shapes your dynamics. Compressors even out volume levels, add sustain, and create the polished sound of professional recordings.

introduction.title: What is Compression?
introduction.text: Compression reduces the dynamic range of your signal by automatically lowering the volume of loud parts and/or raising the volume of quiet parts. This creates a more consistent level and can add sustain, punch, and professional polish.

columns.title: How It Works
columns.text: Monitors input signal level. Reduces gain when signal exceeds threshold. Applies gain reduction at set ratio. Can add makeup gain to compensate. Attack and release control timing. Creates more consistent dynamics.

columns.title: Musical Benefits
columns.text: Even volume levels. Increased sustain. Enhanced picking attack. Better string balance. Improved mix presence. Professional polish.

cards.title: Optical Compressors
cards.description: Use light-dependent resistors for smooth, musical compression. Slow, natural response that's perfect for rhythm guitar and vocals.

fields.label: Examples
fields.value: LA-2A, Empress Compressor, Origin Effects Cali76

cards.title: FET Compressors
cards.description: Field Effect Transistor designs provide fast, punchy compression. Great for adding attack and presence to guitar.

cards.title: VCA Compressors
cards.description: Voltage Controlled Amplifier designs offer precise control and transparent compression.

fields.label: Examples
fields.value: DBX 160X, SSL bus compressors, many modern pedals

cards.title: Tube Compressors
cards.description: Vacuum tube designs add harmonic warmth and musical saturation along with compression.

fields.label: Examples
fields.value: Fairchild 670, Manley Variable Mu, tube pedals

cards.title: MXR Dyna Comp
cards.description: The classic guitar compressor. Simple two-knob design with distinctive character. Used on countless recordings since the 1970s.

fields.label: Signature Sound
fields.value: Punchy, colored compression with enhanced pick attack and sustain.

cards.title: Boss CS-1/CS-2/CS-3
cards.description: Evolution of Boss compressor pedals. The CS-2 is particularly sought after for its musical compression and sustain characteristics.

fields.label: Signature Sound
fields.value: Smooth, musical compression with excellent sustain and note clarity.

cards.title: Empress Compressor
cards.description: Modern optical compressor with extensive controls. Professional studio quality in a pedal format with multiple compression styles.

fields.label: Signature Sound
fields.value: Transparent, musical compression with studio-grade control and quality.

cards.title: Best Practices
items: Use makeup gain to match levels

cards.title: Signal Chain Position
items: Can be used in effects loop

sections.title: Compressor Settings Guide
sections.warningText: Good compression should be felt more than heard. If you notice the compressor working obviously, you might be using too much. The goal is usually musical enhancement, not obvious effect.
